summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026 (period October 2, 2026) transmitting an updated Reference Form 2025 (v4), the Brazilian equivalent of an annual Form 20-F-style registration statement, with base date December 31, 2025. Revisions cover items 1.9, 1.12, 6.4, 6.5, 7.4 and 12.9, spanning auditor, stockholding and governance disclosures. No transaction, stake, price, premium or advisor terms appear. Purely routine disclosure; no deal, no risk-arb angle.
